info.name: EgoMap API
info.description:
Complete EgoMap JSON API (v1) including all enabled modules.

**Setup:** Import collection + both environment files. Select *EgoMap — Development* or *EgoMap — Production* in Postman.

**Auth flow:** Run *Auth → Login* (or *Verify Email*). Token is saved to `bearer_token` automatically.

**Guest flows:** Quiz and Ghost Mode requests auto-save `guest_token` from responses.

Regenerate: `php artisan postman:generate`

request.description: Stripe → Cashier webhook. Requires valid `Stripe-Signature` header (use Stripe CLI: `stripe listen --forward-to {{base_url}}/stripe/webhook`). Not callable manually without a signed payload.
